reviews.author: Wei-Ting Chang
reviews.text: Great Chinese BBQ with authentic flavors. I personally love the lamb and beef skewers, perfect with their homemade chili powder. BBQ lovers must try it! I also recommend their crunch rice bowl, really savory and delicious.

reviews.author: Clinton Dixon
reviews.text: The service was outstanding, the food came out incredibly fast, and everything tasted fresh. Being able to watch the food cooked over an open fire adds to the whole experience and gives it an awesome smoky flavor.

reviews.author: Y Sun
reviews.text: Very authentic Chinese BBQ with a traditional open-fire grilling style that really brings out the flavor of the meat. The seasoning of their skewers was really delicious.
